## Turn 1 — Candidate universe + source map progress note

I will **not** produce the final inventory yet. Retrieval is not sufficient for a complete, primary-sourced, >30 MWe Vietnam thermal-asset reference document. I’ve started the working ledger and separated **discovery leads** from sources likely usable for final justification.

### 1. Initial authoritative / semi-authoritative source map

Likely final-usable sources found so far:

| Source handle | Type | Likely use |
|---|---:|---|
| `EVN-Annual-2024/2025` | EVN annual report, primary/official | National installed capacity totals by fuel and ownership; EVN/GENCO capacity context. |
| `EVN-Annual-2022-2023` | EVN annual report, primary/official | Historical power-system totals; coal/gas capacity reconciliation. |
| `EVN-Overview-2023` | EVN official article | 2023 generation/fuel context; gas and coal supply context. |
| `PDP8-Decision-500-2023` | Prime Minister decision, official | National planning envelope; coal/gas/LNG targets. Need official annex retrieval. |
| `PDP8-Implementation-Decision-262-2024` | Prime Minister decision, official | Project-level PDP8 implementation list. Need official annex retrieval, especially gas/LNG/coal appendices. |
| `Revised-PDP8-Decision-768-2025 / Decision-1509 references` | Government/planning update, official or legal summaries found | Updated planning cycle and transition rules; need official text/annexes. |
| `MOIT-Key-Energy-Projects-2634-2025` | MOIT / PM decision notice | Current list of national key energy projects, including LNG terminals and gas-to-power chains. |
| `EVNGENCO3-Annual-2024` | Operator annual report | Phú Mỹ, Vĩnh Tân 2, Mông Dương 1 operating status, O&M references to Phú Mỹ 3 / Vĩnh Tân 4. |
| `EVNGENCO3-Annual-2023` | Operator annual report | Plant details and self-consumption / operation context. |
| `PVPower-Annual-2024` | Listed company annual report | Cà Mau 1–2, Nhơn Trạch 1–2, Vũng Áng 1, Nhơn Trạch 3–4 status and ownership. |

Useful but **not final-justification** unless traced to primary:

| Source handle | Type | Use only as |
|---|---:|---|
| Mayer Brown / Legal500 / VILAF / KPMG PDP8 summaries | Law-firm / advisory summaries | Discovery and cross-checking of PDP8 project lists. |
| Wikipedia / scraped power-station lists | Tertiary | Discovery only; not final evidence. |
| GEM trackers | Tracker | Discovery / gap-check; final only if primary cannot be found and clearly labelled LOW, but I will first trace all rows to primary/operator/lender sources. |
| Trade press / securities news | Secondary | Status freshness where official/operator source is absent; capped per confidence rules. |
